title: Installments Collected on an Overdue Home Delivery Pharmacy Payment Plan
content:
## Billing office rule: how many installments are collected

**Rule.** On a Home Delivery Pharmacy payment plan, the number of installments collected depends on how far behind the plan is: every overdue installment when two or more are overdue, the overdue installment together with the plan's final installment when exactly one is overdue and only the final installment remains after it, and the one overdue installment in every other case. Each installment collected is at the monthly installment recorded on the confirmed plan.

Installments of a payment plan fall due monthly, the first one month after the plan's request date, so the number fallen due is the number of whole months from the plan's request date to the handling date. The number overdue is the number fallen due less the highest installment number carried by the plan installment payments posted on the account. "Only the final installment remains after it" means the plan's months recorded on the confirmed plan are one more than the number fallen due.

### Method by how far behind

| Installments overdue | Installments remaining after the overdue one | Installments collected |
|---|---|---|
| 2 or more | any | every overdue installment |
| exactly 1 | only the final installment | 2: the overdue one and the final one, closing the plan |
| exactly 1 | more than the final installment | 1 |

### Worked cases (hypothetical plans)

| Plan months | Whole months since request (fallen due) | Highest installment number posted | Overdue | Collected |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 6 | 4 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| 6 | 5 | 1 | 4 | 4 |
| 3 | 2 | 1 | 1 | 2 (overdue plus final) |
| 6 | 3 | 2 | 1 | 1 |

With a monthly installment of 84.34, collecting 2 installments comes to 168.68 and collecting 4 comes to 337.36.
